tasks.subject: Task 1: rascal plugin scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `rascal` is installable from the existing marketplace as an empty plugin with notices and source pins.

**Verify:** `node --test scripts/test/manifest.test.mjs plugins/rascal/test/manifest.test.mjs` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files":["plugins/rascal/.claude-plugin/plugin.json","plugins/rascal/sources.json","plugins/rascal/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md","plugins/rascal/test/manifest.test.mjs",".claude-plugin/marketplace.json","scripts/test/manifest.test.mjs:24-32"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test scripts/test/manifest.test.mjs plugins/rascal/test/manifest.test.mjs` → all pass","acceptanceCriteria":["The marketplace lists `intelligentrascal` (source `./`) and `rascal` (source `./plugins/rascal`).","rascal's plugin.json has no `dependencies` (standalone, Q2).","`sources.json` pins Pocock at the commit in `upstream.json` (`3cca18b368ae95cdbdebbff572ccafa662551015`), and obra/superpowers, pcvelz/superpowers and cursor/plugins with `commit: null` (not derived from yet).","THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES carries Pocock's MIT text."]}
```

```json:metadata
{"files":["plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-grilling/{SKILL.md,agents/openai.yaml}","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-domain-modeling/{SKILL.md,CONTEXT-FORMAT.md,ADR-FORMAT.md,agents/openai.yaml}","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-grill-me/SKILL.md","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-grill-with-docs/SKILL.md","plugins/rascal/test/skills.test.mjs"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test plugins/rascal/test/skills.test.mjs` → pass","acceptanceCriteria":["Each SKILL.md frontmatter `name` equals its folder name.","Each derived skill has a provenance header naming source, path and the pinned commit, matching `sources.json`.","No rascal skill references `mattpocock-skills:` or tells the user to install Pocock.","The grilling and domain-modeling bodies are Pocock's text verbatim below the header (copy-and-edit, Q13). tasks.subject: Task 3: Transport mirror (`sync-transport`)
```
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `scripts/sync-transport.mjs` mirrors intelligentrascal's grill transport into `plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-grilling-ui/`, rewriting only SKILL.md and openai.yaml. `--check` reports drift.

**Verify:** `node --test scripts/test/sync-transport.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-transport.mjs --check` → pass, then `sync-transport: in sync`

```json:metadata
{"files":["scripts/sync-transport.mjs","scripts/test/sync-transport.test.mjs","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-grilling-ui/**"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test scripts/test/sync-transport.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-transport.mjs --check` → pass, then `sync-transport: in sync`","acceptanceCriteria":["`hub.mjs`, `lib/*.mjs`, `page/*` and `visual-brief.md` are byte-identical to `skills/grilling-ui/`. Tests are not copied.","The generated SKILL.md has `name: rascal-grilling-ui`, a rascal description, and no `Pocock`, `mattpocock` or `intelligentrascal` strings. Every backticked `grilling`, `domain-modeling` and `grilling-ui` reference is `rascal-`-prefixed.","`--check` exits 0 when in sync and 1 listing drifted paths otherwise, and writes nothing.","Running the script twice changes nothing on the second run.","`skills/grilling-ui/` is untouched (intelligentrascal behaviour unchanged)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Privacy scrub
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `scripts/scrub.mjs` finds personal data in files. Generic patterns always run; the local deny-list (`~/.rascal/denylist.txt`) is added when present; an allowlist suppresses known-fine hits.

**Verify:** `node --test scripts/test/scrub.test.mjs && node scripts/scrub.mjs --all` → pass, then `scrub: clean`

```json:metadata
{"files":["plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-retro/lib/redact.mjs","scripts/scrub.mjs","scripts/test/scrub.test.mjs",".scrub-allow"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test scripts/test/scrub.test.mjs && node scripts/scrub.mjs --all` → pass, then `scrub: clean`","acceptanceCriteria":["Generic patterns cover home paths with a real username (`/Users/<name>/`, `/home/<name>/`; `~` paths are fine), emails, and token shapes (`sk-`, `sk-ant-`, `ghp_`, `gho_`, `github_pat_`, `AKIA`, `xox[bp]-`, PEM private keys).","The deny-list file has one case-insensitive literal per line; `#` starts a comment.","`.scrub-allow` lines are `path-glob` (whole file) or `path-glob:literal` (that text in that file).","Modes: `--staged` (files in the git index), `--all` (all tracked files), or explicit paths; `--generic` skips the deny-list.","Exit 0 when clean, 1 with `file:line: kind` lines (never printing the matched secret), 2 on usage error.","`node scripts/scrub.mjs --all` is clean on the repo after this task."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Pre-commit hook and CI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every commit runs the scrub on staged files (with the deny-list) and the transport `--check`. Every push and PR runs the generic scrub in CI.

**Verify:** the two refusal checks in Step 3 → both refused; `git commit` of clean changes → succeeds

```json:metadata
{"files":[".githooks/pre-commit","scripts/setup-hooks.sh",".github/workflows/privacy.yml"],"verifyCommand":"the two refusal checks in Step 3 → both refused; `git commit` of clean changes → succeeds","acceptanceCriteria":["After `scripts/setup-hooks.sh`, `git config core.hooksPath` is `.githooks`.","A staged file containing `/Users/alice/` is refused with the scrub's output.","Editing `skills/grilling-ui/lib/util.mjs` without re-running sync-transport is refused.","CI runs `node scripts/scrub.mjs --all --generic` only. Per Q34, the transport check is not in CI."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: `install-rascal.sh` for Codex, OpenCode and Pi
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One command links every rascal skill into `~/.agents/skills` and creates the `~/.rascal/` scaffold. It installs no upstreams (Q20) and leaves `install-agents.sh` untouched.

**Verify:** `node --test scripts/test/install-rascal.test.mjs` → pass

```json:metadata
{"files":["scripts/install-rascal.sh","scripts/test/install-rascal.test.mjs"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test scripts/test/install-rascal.test.mjs` → pass","acceptanceCriteria":["Every folder under `plugins/rascal/skills/` is symlinked into `$AGENTS_SKILLS_DIR` (default `~/.agents/skills`) under the same name.","Re-running is a no-op. A real directory in the way exits 1 and links nothing.","Creates `$RASCAL_HOME` (default `~/.rascal`, mode 700) with `mining/`, a commented `denylist.txt` template and an empty `preferences.md`, and never overwrites existing files.","Prints the Claude Code install line: `claude plugin marketplace add intelligentrascal/skills && claude plugin install rascal@intelligentrascal`."]}
```

A slash command becomes a skill `{via: \"command\"}` and its args become the turn text.","A `Skill` tool_use becomes `{via: \"tool\", name: input.skill}`.","Text is redacted (generic + deny-list) and clipped to 4000 chars per turn.","Desktop `audit.jsonl` lines (`session_id`, `client_platform`) parse with the same function."]}

tasks.subject: Task 13: The `rascal-retro` skill, docs and smoke record
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `/rascal-retro` runs the miner, analyzes the digest with subagents, writes findings locally, and ends in a grill. With `--all`, that grill is the seed grill that picks v1. README and the smoke record are updated.

**Verify:** `node --test plugins/rascal/test/skills.test.mjs` → pass; then the full repo test command → pass

```json:metadata
{"files":["plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-retro/SKILL.md","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-retro/agents/openai.yaml","plugins/rascal/skills/rascal-retro/analyst-brief.md","docs/superpowers/verification/2026-10-02-rascal-smoke.md","plugins/rascal/test/skills.test.mjs","README.md"],"verifyCommand":"`node --test plugins/rascal/test/skills.test.mjs` → pass; then the full repo test command → pass","acceptanceCriteria":["The SKILL.md drives `mine.mjs` via `$SKILL`, never reads raw transcripts, and writes findings only under `~/.rascal/mining/`.","Findings are classified `generic` or `personal` (Q14). Personal ones only ever become proposed `~/.rascal/preferences.md` entries, after the user accepts them in the grill.","`--all` ends by running `rascal-grill-me-ui` with the seed topic and doc `docs/rascal-v1-design.md`. Its first round covers: v1 workflows; the canonical skill per concept (TDD, debugging, review, planning, grilling) and which upstream it derives from; the just-do-it rule; the wayfinder × playbook experiment (Q29); and each personal preference to adopt.","Incremental mode (`/rascal-retro`) reads only records extracted since `last-retro`, and also ends in a grill (the topic is the proposals).","After the grill's Finish, it runs `mark-retro`.","README documents rascal: install (Claude Code + `install-rascal.sh`), the skills list, `setup-hooks.sh`, `~/.rascal/` and the new test command."]}
```
